ranking.name: Air temperature near the ground
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, air temperature near the ground in the whole globe changed by +0.272 °C per decade (95% confidence interval +0.258 to +0.286), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.670 °C.

ranking.name: Water in the topsoil
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water in the topsoil in the whole globe shows no statistically significant trend (p = 0.21): the estimate is −0.032 kg/m² per decade (95% confidence interval −0.081 to +0.019). This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.

This does not mean nothing changed; the data cannot tell a trend this small apart from natural ups and downs.
